title: What If Gravity Turned Off For 35 Seconds?
sources: NASA Science, Microgravity: with no apparent gravity people and unsecured objects float and keep drifting
Newton's first law (NASA): an object at rest stays at rest, and in motion stays in motion, unless a force acts on it - loose things drift until gravity returns
Ready.gov / general safety: when gravity returns, falling objects are the hazard - get under something sturdy and stay away from windows and shelves

lines.text: So what would you do if gravity switched off for thirty-five seconds?
lines.caps: So what would *you | do if *gravity | switched *off? | thirty-five *seconds?

lines.text: At first it would be amazing, your feet leave the floor and everything loose floats up.
lines.caps: At first it *would | feet leave the *floor | everything loose *floats up.

lines.text: Step one: grab something solid and hold on tight.
Step two: stay away from windows and shelves, because they will come down.
lines.caps: Step *two: | stay away from *windows | they come *down.

lines.text: Step three: get under something sturdy, because falling objects are the real danger.
lines.caps: Step *three: | get under something *sturdy | the real *danger.

lines.text: Your dog, your coffee, your couch - everything you own is floating above your head.
lines.caps: Your *dog, | your *coffee, | everything you own *floating | above your *head.

lines.text: Then, exactly thirty-five seconds later, gravity snaps back - and everything crashes down.
lines.caps: Then exactly thirty-five *seconds | gravity snaps *back | everything crashes *down.
